posts.text: Braves 6, Phillies 2. The season ends in the Wild Card Series, and a long winter awaits the Phillies.

reply_texts.text: Thanks for everything you do, as always.

reply_texts.text: Sending Kemp out there like that is some cold coward shit.
reply_texts.author: secondbeerrun.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: see you in June, Matt -- thanks for all the work, you are the best there is in the Phillies arena
reply_texts.author: norseofbroad.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: Matt, you are elite. Thanks for everything! ❤️
reply_texts.author: lauren-nicole.bsky.social

posts.jp: Braves 6、Phillies 2。シーズンはワイルドカードシリーズで終了、Philliesは長い冬を迎える。

posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: It's closing time for the Phillies. Ozzie Albies homers off Zack Wheeler to make it 5-0.
posts.jp: Philliesのシーズンは終わり。Ozzie Albiesがミスターをホームランで4点目。

posts.author: Jen McCaffrey
posts.text: Red Sox announce Mickey Gasper underwent a successful Distal Biceps tendon repair today
posts.jp: Red Soxが発表：Mickey Gasperが本日、上腕二頭筋腱の修復手術に成功。

posts.author: Meghan Montemurro
posts.text: Jed Hoyer on how he will approach spending on relief market: “I did a poor job in the bullpen this year — full stop. … So I take responsibility for that and something that we'll look to improve on this offseason because it didn't work out as well as it did in ‘25 this last year.”

reply_texts.text: I think a bigger problem is the Cubs haven't been able to develop relievers. There's no reason a guy like Jordan Wicks, for example, couldn't become a useful RP.
reply_texts.author: dogcolumbo.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: I was was pleased with Hoyer's off-season bullpen acquistions. They looked good to me then, and I'm not going to succumb now to the confirmation bias Maddon used to caution us about. Hoyer's acquisitions spectacularly didn't work out. But who of us in February foresaw anything *like* what happened?
reply_texts.author: nerhaugen.bsky.social

reply_texts.text:
The organization also hasn't created a successful SP pipeline. Every team has pitching injuries, w/ plenty of season-ending ones to go around. If your org doesn't have budding SP in the minors pushing to move up, it gets the 2026 #Cubs rotation.
Pitching, in general, is completely broken.
reply_texts.author: thegratefulcub.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: I think establishing, either signing or developing, your closer is a must. Knowing you need 24 outs, then you can just hand it to your closer to get the final 3 is a must. It will make everything so much easier to fill in the middle innings. Let everyone know their roles.
reply_texts.author: ccharles83.bsky.social

posts.jp: Jed Hoyerがリリーフ市場への支出方針：「リリーフ投手の起用で今季失敗した。責任を取り、オフシーズンに改善するつもりだ。'25年ほどうまくいかなかった」

posts.author: Chandler Rome
posts.text: Happy @mlbtraderumors.bsky.social arbitration projection day to you and yours. It was a good year for Peter Lambert. It will be a more difficult winter for whoever is running the Astros’ baseball operations department
posts.jp: アービトレーション予想日おめでとう。Peter Lambertにとっていい年だった。Astrosの野球運営部門を担当する者にとっては厳しい冬が待っている。

posts.author: Meghan Montemurro
posts.text: Jed Hoyer on the Cubs’ season: “Ultimately, as we sit here today, it feels like we let something slip away and I think that's probably the hardest thing. These fans deserve home playoff games. We let home field slip away by playing poorly in September, especially the last week.”
posts.jp: Jed Hoyerが今季を振り返る：「結果的に、チャンスを逃してしまった。ファンはホーム球場でのプレーオフに値する。9月の不振で、特に最終週で本拠地を失わせてしまった」
